title: Normalized pullback identity and bridge mate
statement: For an Operations package, its section-normalized Compositors, a CanonicalBridge and a scheme X, there exists an identity comparison e : pull(1_X) ≅ id such that the identity-pair pullback compositor satisfies the right-unitor equation and the adjoint conjugate of e identifies with the canonical bridge direct-image identity followed by the intrinsic semilinear sId.

source.place: Tags 07A7 and 0F7C, identity normalization under adjunction conjugation

proof.text: Compose the section-normalized CanonicalBridge.ordinary identity with the intrinsic semilinear pushId. Its components are restriction along pullbackId.inv. The sections certificate of Compositors.ordinaryDirect and the site pullback left-unit law identify its identity-first compositor with this identity whiskered by direct image, including the equality transport.

Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_comp_id and the equality-transport mate formula to obtain the ordinary inverse-image unit equation. Localize its identity comparison. The proved ordinaryPull_eq, pullComp_eq and derived_transport helpers in IntegralSystemCompositorAssociativity identify the packaged compositors with the localized ones; descend_left_unit in StrictTowerDirectImageCoherence gives the required derived unit equation.

Adjoint uniqueness identifies the ordinary identity comparison with the ordinary bridge inverse-image comparison followed by the semilinear inverse-image identity. Localization preserves this composition. Conjugating its inverse, using the proved conjugateIso_trans helper of AdjunctionSquareComposition, gives exactly CanonicalBridge.push followed by the intrinsic semilinear sId.

proof_origin.place: Identity and coefficient coherence; sectionwise identity normalization, ordinary adjunction uniqueness and exact derived localization (V1, 2026-10-26).

lean.statement:
theorem systemPushIdentityPullUnit (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ e : pull l E (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 (System l E X),
      eqToIso (congrArg (pull l E) (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫
          c.pullComp (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pull l E (𝟙 X)) e ≪≫
          Functor.rightUnitor (pull l E (𝟙 X)) = Iso.refl _ ∧
      conjugateIsoEquiv (o.direct (𝟙 X)).adj Adjunction.id e.symm =
        b.push l E (𝟙 X) ≪≫
          ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.sId (scalarRings l E)
            (scalarTransitions l E) X
